task.description: Design and implement test coverage for IDN-03 role-based access behavior. Produce tests/specs/IDN-03.md with requirement traceability and add/adjust test cases that verify: (1) TASK_WORKER-only create definition is denied with 403, (2) TASK_WORKER + PROCESS_OPERATOR can cancel instance, (3) GET /tasks applies row-level filtering for TASK_WORKER including group membership behavior, and (4) endpoints not in the permission matrix default to PLATFORM_ADMIN-only authorization semantics. Ensure tests are executable in existing unit/integration suites and aligned with current project test conventions.
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated IDN-03 test spec exists with traceability to all acceptance criteria
Automated tests cover deny, allow, and row-filter paths for IDN-03
Default PLATFORM_ADMIN fallback behavior is covered by at least one test
Tests compile and integrate with existing test targets

result.summary: Delivered IDN-03 test design with a dedicated spec, authorization unit coverage for deny/allow/fallback semantics, and integration coverage for TASK_WORKER task-list row filtering including group membership behavior.
